key.name: client-id
key.description: Client ID for WHOOP API authentication

key.name: client-secret
key.description: Client Secret for WHOOP API authentication

key.name: access-token
key.description: Access token for WHOOP API requests

key.name: refresh-token
key.description: Refresh token for WHOOP API authentication

key.name: is-authenticated
key.description: Whether the user is authenticated with WHOOP

key.name: show-recovery
key.description: Whether to show the recovery score in the top panel

key.name: show-sleep
key.description: Whether to show the sleep performance in the top panel

key.name: show-strain
key.description: Whether to show the daily strain in the top panel

key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often to refresh WHOOP data, in minutes

key.name: panel-show-icons
key.description: Whether to show metric icons in the top panel

key.name: panel-show-unit
key.description: Whether to show the % symbol next to values in the top panel

key.name: temp-unit
key.description: Unit for displaying skin temperature (celsius or fahrenheit)

key.name: notify-low-recovery
key.description: Send a notification when recovery score falls below threshold

key.name: notify-recovery-threshold
key.description: Send notification when recovery score falls below this value
